prompt.project_info: Create a candid luxury-bathroom mirror selfie during a warm morning getting-ready moment.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with vibrant copper-red hair in a messy high bun, loose face-framing strands, fair skin with natural freckles, blue-grey eyes, and direct neutral gaze, wearing a plush white bathrobe securely wrapped and closed.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level waist-up mirror selfie with phone, beige polished marble tiles, large vanity mirror, glass shower enclosure, simple ring, cream patterned phone case, and warm recessed ceiling lights.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-yellow warm artificial bathroom light, intimate casual candid preparation mood, realistic robe and skin texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror selfie, medium waist-up framing, natural color, sharp hair and freckles, realistic reflection.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A candid photorealistic waist-up mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with vibrant copper-red hair in a messy high bun, loose wavy strands framing her face, fair skin with prominent natural freckles, blue-grey eyes, and a direct neutral gaze. She wears a plush white bathrobe securely wrapped and closed at the chest, holding an iPhone-style phone with a cream animal-spot case and wearing a simple thin ring. The luxury bathroom has beige polished marble or stone tiles, a large vanity mirror, a glass shower enclosure, and warm recessed ceiling lights. Use golden-yellow indoor light, realistic robe and skin texture, sharp hair and freckles, and a casual getting-ready morning atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, robe open, exposed chest, lingerie, towel-only coverage, sexualized mirror pose, nudity, logos, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hair, freckles, bathroom, robe, phone, and warm light; keep robe securely closed and replace any case motif with generic pattern. Avoid logos and typography.

changes: Clarified approved adult and changed off-shoulder/open robe exposure to a securely wrapped closed bathrobe, preserving the getting-ready bathroom selfie.
